observation.limitations: The declared 63-sample window is the prior alpha.2 review, not the newer cohort. Separate alpha.10 read-only profile aggregates on October 11 show Astra 3 selections across 18 conditional opportunities, summed expected selections 2.868. No Session IDs or sequence in aggregates. Bounded native metadata from the requested local Session shows five Sol turns followed by two Astra turns; the last has 178 steps under one frozen allocation. Tail scan is limited, not full history. Actual per-turn pool/weights are not durably retained. Two user-reported valid unknown classifier results are not a population unknown rate. No content, credentials or raw export uploaded.

previousReview: Prior #332/#333/#334, alpha.11 #411 and alpha.12 #413. User clarified on October 11 that every eligible fitting model should retain positive opportunity across categories, not just within one category (#414). No newer live v3 outcome sample is available; retain #334.
findings: Prior 63 decisions cannot attribute later incidents. Valid unknown is not a timeout. Projection regressions establish avoidable anchor loss/incidental-omission downgrade, not the actual task root cause. The reported Astra streak is two allocations, not 178 independent choices. Under an explicitly assumed two-model category pool, production Session/turn seeds reproduce both Astra choices at conditional shares 11.8% then 23.1%; this is conditional reproduction, not recovered decision evidence. A 20000-turn synthetic fixed-previous v1 scan yields 4563 Astra hits and 1014 adjacent pairs, showing runs are possible, not proving actual distribution conformity. No observed aggregate inflation is established. V1 intentionally grants marked continuity; the user now requests a stricter cost preference, not a statistically proven RNG repair.
decision: High-cost-v4 replaces hard category filtering with positive per-model category factors: target 1, second 0.25, third 0.05 in the existing category order, unknown explicitly 0.02. Multiply by v3 ordinary/previous/high-cost/previous-high-cost weights 1/1.5/0.2/0.02. All hard-eligible fitting models participate; exact exclusions, current account/capability proof, input modality and headroom remain hard guards. These are uncalibrated biased trial coefficients, not optimal probabilities, quality evidence or fixed category quotas. Candidate population affects category totals. Intentionally permit non-target draws without task-failure inference, extra calls or in-turn switches. No-fit native recovery and auxiliary classifier policy remain unchanged. Capture candidate category/factor; preserve strict v1/v2/v3 historical explanations/cohorts and no-evidence opt-out. No new persistent population or measured quality/cost claim.
validation: Five regression-first cross-category tests failed under v3. V3 and v4 actual selectors each ran 19 synthetic scenarios with 100000 Session/turn seeds per scenario. V4 retained positive observed opportunity for all fitting candidates; every expected/observed share differed by less than 0.5 percentage points. The six-model sequential v4 fixture selected marked Powerful 8577 times and recorded 93 adjacent marked pairs; ordinary Powerful 61215, Versatile 12705/12632, Lightweight 2410/2461. This is implementation evidence, not independent production probability or quality. Checked-in scripts/simulate-auto-distribution.mjs reproduces the matrix. Full pnpm verify passed: 2788 Vitest tests, 2 expected skips, 340 tooling tests, types/build/package smoke. Final exact-weight codec refinement passed 21 focused tests. Correct candidate-category aggregation, strict factor validation, legacy v1/v2/v3 codecs and evidence opt-out are covered. Native gateways and saved-mark/restart run in required CI, pending before merge. Local pack/tarball passed; recheck the final candidate after this review update. No real model calls, credentials, live metadata reads, profile changes or Desktop restart.

followUp.metric: By producer/policy and target/actual candidate category, compare selected/no-fit counts, opportunities and conditional expected selections. Split marked previous/base weights and population changes. Adjacent-turn rates require observed sequence, never daily aggregates. Track labeled outcomes of non-target selections before interpreting selection diversity as success, quality or savings. Legacy absence remains unknown.
followUp.action: Review cross-category opportunity and task-quality regressions before retaining or tuning the declared factors; keep v1/v2/v3/v4 separate. No automatic parameter tuning, upload or live benchmark. Revert soft-category policy if reviewed outcomes reject the trial; retain genuine uncertainty and linked #334.
